cards.ex: He's a seasoned player; don't underestimate him just because he's getting older.
cards.exUz: U tajribali o'yinchi; uning yoshi o'tib qolganiga qarab past baho bermang.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida o'ynab, katta tajribaga ega bo'lgan o'yinchi.

cards.ex: She's an ardent supporter of the local team and never misses a game.
cards.exUz: U mahalliy jamoaning ashaddiy muxlisi va hech qachon birorta o'yinni qoldirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ishtiyoqli va qiziquvchan muxlis.

cards.ex: I try to keep in shape by jogging regularly and eating healthy food.
cards.exUz: Men muntazam yugurish va sog'lom ovqatlanish orqali formani saqlashga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatni yaxshi saqlash, sog'lom bo'lish.

cards.ex: Gardening is a recreational activity that many people find relaxing.
cards.exUz: Bog'dorchilik - bu ko'p odamlarga dam beruvchi ko'ngilochar faoliyatdir.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish, hordiq chiqarish uchun qilinadigan mashg'ulot.

cards.ex: The controversial refereeing decision only fanned the flames of the rivalry between the two teams.
cards.exUz: Bahsli hakamlik qarori ikki jamoa o'rtasidagi raqobat olovini yanada kuchaytirdi.
cards.uzDef: Bahsni, g'azabni yoki qiziqishni kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: Even though they were the underdogs, they still had a sporting chance of winning the championship.
cards.exUz: Ular omadsiz bo'lishsa ham, chempionatda g'alaba qozonish uchun imkoniyatlari bor edi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun adolatli imkoniyat.

cards.ex: We're all rooting for you in the final match!
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz seni final uchrashuvida qo'llab-quvvatlaymiz!
cards.uzDef: Jamoani yoki o'yinchini muvaffaqiyatga erishishini xohlash va qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: He's a keen follower of Formula 1 racing and knows all the drivers.
cards.exUz: U Formula 1 poygalarining qiziquvchan kuzatuvchisi va barcha haydovchilarni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda qiziqib, muntazam kuzatib boradigan odam.

cards.ex: I get a real buzz from playing live music in front of an audience.
cards.exUz: Men tomoshabinlar oldida jonli musiqa ijro etishdan haqiqiy hayajon olaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan kuchli hayajon his qilish, zavqlanish.

cards.ex: She's a die-hard fan of the band and has seen them in concert dozens of times.
cards.exUz: U guruhning sadoqatli muxlisi va ularning konsertlarida o'nlab marta qatnashgan.
cards.uzDef: Jamoaga yoki o'yinchiga juda sadoqatli, hech qachon voz kechmaydigan muxlis.

cards.ex: A quiet walk in the park was a welcome respite from the stress of work.
cards.exUz: Bog'da tinchgina sayr qilish ishning stressidan yoqimli tanaffus bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki zerikarli narsadan keyin kelgan yoqimli dam olish.

cards.ex: The coffee shop is a regular haunt for students studying for exams.
cards.exUz: Qahvaxona imtihonlarga tayyorlanayotgan talabalar uchun doimiy joydir.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar tez-tez boradigan joy, odatda dam olish uchun.

cards.ex: Joining a book club is a great social outlet for people who love reading.
cards.exUz: Kitob klubiga a'zo bo'lish kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'radigan odamlar uchun ajoyib ijtimoiy muloqotdir.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan muloqot qilish va aloqa o'rnatish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: She's a tough competitor and never gives up, even when she's behind.
cards.exUz: U qattiq raqobatchi va hatto orqada qolsa ham, hech qachon taslim bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun kurashadigan kuchli raqib.

cards.ex: He plays in a recreational league to stay active and have fun.
cards.exUz: U faol bo'lish va zavqlanish uchun havaskorlar ligasida o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Sportni professional bo'lmagan, havaskorlar darajasida o'ynash uchun tashkil etilgan liga.

cards.ex: She's really in her element when she's on stage performing.
cards.exUz: U sahnada chiqish qilganda o'zini juda qulay his qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini juda qulay, baxtli va muvaffaqiyatli his qiladigan vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He relishes the challenge of climbing difficult mountains.
cards.exUz: U qiyin tog'larga chiqish qiyinchiliklaridan zavqlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vazifani qiziqarli va o'ziga xos deb bilish, undan zavqlanish.

cards.ex: The annual arts festival is a big draw for tourists.
cards.exUz: Yillik san'at festivali sayyohlar uchun kattakon o'yindir.
cards.uzDef: Katta auditoriyani jalb qiladigan voqea yoki shaxs.

cards.ex: She's such a social butterfly; she knows everyone at the party.
cards.exUz: U juda ijtimoiy kapalak; u ziyofatda hamma odamlarni taniydi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar bilan tez va oson muloqotga kirishadigan odam.

cards.ex: After his stellar performance, he's a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Uning ajoyib chiqishidan so'ng, undan yaxshiroq natija ko'rsatish qiyin vazifa.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgisidan yaxshiroq natijaga erishish qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The team hasn't been up to par lately, and they need to improve their performance.
cards.exUz: Jamoa oxirgi paytlarda standartga mos kelmayapti va ular o'z o'yinlarini yaxshilashlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan standartlarga javob berish yoki yaxshi natija ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: We need to ensure a level playing field so that everyone has a fair chance to succeed.
cards.exUz: Biz barchaga muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun teng imkoniyatlar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barcha ishtirokchilar uchun teng sharoitlar va imkoniyatlar.

cards.ex: Our new project manager is really on the ball and gets things done quickly.
cards.exUz: Bizning yangi loyiha menejerimiz juda tezkor va ishlarni tezda bajaradi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatli, tezkor va vaziyatni yaxshi tushunadigan odam.

cards.ex: It's getting late; let's call it a day and go home.
cards.exUz: Kech bo'lyapti; keling, ishni tugatamiz va uyga boramiz.
cards.uzDef: Ishni yoki mashg'ulotni tugatish, dam olishga vaqt ajratish.

cards.ex: Her enthusiasm for the project was a breath of fresh air.
cards.exUz: Uning loyihaga bo'lgan ishtiyoqi yangilik edi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, tetiklantiruvchi va ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatadigan narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: Losing the game at the last minute was a tough break for the team.
cards.exUz: O'yinni oxirgi daqiqada yutqazish jamoa uchun omadsizlik bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Afsuski, omadsizlik yoki yomon vaziyat.

cards.ex: We like to explore places that are off the beaten path when we travel.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilganimizda odamlarsiz joylarni o'rganishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Odatda sayyohlar kam boradigan, tinch va sokin joy.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get the hang of playing the guitar.
cards.exUz: Gitara chalishni o'rganib olish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ko'nikmani yoki ishni qanday bajarishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: Even to a casual observer, it was clear that the team was struggling.
cards.exUz: Hatto oddiy kuzatuvchiga ham jamoaning qiynalayotgani aniq edi.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur qiziqmasdan, shunchaki kuzatib turadigan odam.

cards.ex: The team is on a roll, winning their last five games.
cards.exUz: Jamoaning omadi chopmoqda, ular oxirgi beshta o'yinda g'alaba qozonishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ketma-ket muvaffaqiyatga erishish, omadi kelish.
